title: Recursive ternary majority formula
statement: For each natural number $d$, define a function on sign assignments to the depth-$d$ address space by recursion: at depth $0$ it returns the assigned sign at the unique address. At depth $d+1$, it applies three-input majority to the outputs of the depth-$d$ formulas in the three blocks indexed by $0,1,2$.
hypotheses_covered: the input assigns a sign to every address in the depth-$d$ address space
